name: Grand Admiral Pitta's torpedo sphere
description: Grand Admiral Pitta's torpedo sphere was a nineteen-hundred-meter vessel that Grand Admiral Danetta Pitta took command of when he became a warlord independent from the Galactic Empire. In 5 ABY's Battle of Tralus, Pitta used the torpedo sphere to decimate the warship armada of rival Grand Admiral Josef Grunger, but the latter then rammed his flagship, the Aggressor, into Pitta's craft, killing both of them.
